messages:
Anika Ramos: FYI I got a phone page from PagerDuty but there's no corresponding message in #incidents. Did incident-bot miss it or did the channel rule suppress things? :rotating_light:
PagerDuty Bot: [pagerduty] Alert triggered: RW-API-500s (incident key: abc123). Notified: Primary Oncall (Mark Li).
Mark Li: I got the page on my phone at 10:07pm, but I don't see any thread or automated runbook in Slack. I assumed someone on-call would post.
Anika Ramos: Hmm. I see a webhook delivery in PD with status 200, but the integration endpoint returned 502 when incident-bot tried to create the thread.
Jay Chen: Looking at infra logs now — our incident-bot webhook endpoint (ingress at /hooks/pd) returned 502 -> upstream timeout to /api/v1/create-thread. Seeing a spike around 22:07. Grabbing logs:
```
curl -i -X POST https://infra.example.com/hooks/pd -d @payload.json
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"upstream timeout"}
```
Priya Shah: Could be overload from the nightly soak tests. We had extra traffic on the messaging cluster. Any CPU spikes on the bot pods?
Jay Chen: kubectl logs -n infra deployment/incident-bot --tail=200 shows repeated 504s talking to message-queue and then OOM-kill on one replica.
```
I0520 22:06:59.123 api_request.go:45] dispatching create-thread
E0520 22:07:00.456 upstream.go:88] POST /api/v1/create-thread -> context deadline exceeded
SIGKILL: oom-kill
```
Anika Ramos: ops-health-bot shows a suppression rule applied to the #incidents channel for 'queued-maintenance' between 22:00-23:00. Could PagerDuty mapping be impacted by that rule?
ops-health-bot: Channel automation: suppression rule active on #incidents (maintenance-window). Incoming integration messages are queued, not posted.
Priya Shah: Ah — that suppression was meant for noisy ops-alerts, but we didn't whitelist PagerDuty webhook user. So PD pages were queued and not surfaced. That explains the missing thread even before the OOM on incident-bot.
Mark Li: So two failures: 1) webhook deliveries hit incident-bot which then failed under load, 2) channel automation suppression queued the message, so even when bot recovered nothing posted. I missed the page flow because the phone page showed but the Slack trace was blank. Not obvious at 2am.
Anika Ramos: Can someone manually re-run the PD webhook or escalate? Customers might be impacted if API 500s are still happening.
Jay Chen: I triggered a manual re-delivery from PD for the alert key abc123. Also I'm restarting incident-bot deployment with 2 -> 4 replicas and bumping memory request. Running: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/incident-bot -n infra`
Priya Shah: I patched the channel suppression rule to add 'pagerduty-bot' and 'incident-bot' to whitelist. That should stop queuing.
Incident Bot: Reconnected to message-queue. Processed 3 queued events and created threads for 2 of them. One failed (retry scheduled).
Jay Chen: After restart, incident-bot logs show successful create-thread -> Slack API 200. Threads posted in #incidents now.
Mark Li: I see the thread and the runbook. I acknowledge the PagerDuty incident. Handing over to @Priya for mitigation.
Priya Shah: Running quick rollback on the API canary to stop the 500s, and enabling extra autoscaling on the app tier. Patch command: `kubectl set image deploy/api api=registry:redwood/api:20250520-hotfix`
Anika Ramos: Customer impact: we observed a handful of 500s for ~12 minutes before mitigation — mapped to a small percentage of traffic (~0.3% requests). No data loss. We'll classify P2 with customer-visible error bursts.
Mark Li: Hand-off note: incoming on-call at 23:00 is Jay. Priya will stay until the rollback finishes and then hand to Jay. Please annotate PD notes with 'incidentbot webhook 502 + suppression rule'.
Priya Shah: Done. PD note updated and I added timeline + action items.
Anika Ramos: Postmortem action items: (1) whitelist PD/incident-bot in channel suppression rules (Priya), (2) add circuit-breaker / backpressure to incident-bot path (Jay), (3) set memory HPA for incident-bot and alert when replica OOMs (Infra), (4) run a webhook delivery healthcheck test every 5 minutes (SRE).
Mark Li: Also add an explicit message to oncall runbook: if phone page received but no slack thread within 2 minutes, call the backup pager and escalate.
Jay Chen: Creating follow-up tickets and linking in the incident thread. I'll keep monitoring for 1 hour then demote to watch.
Anika Ramos: Thanks everyone. Closing the live mitigation portion. We'll draft the postmortem and share in #postmortems tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Priya Shah: quick note — one PD retransmit created the thread immediately after restart; confirm any customers still seeing errors and I'll reopen.
Mark Li: All stable from my side. Good job.
ops-health-bot: Automation: suppression rule change applied by Priya Shah at 22:31.
Incident Bot: All queued events processed. Next retry scheduled: none.
